name: redstart-twig
description: Lightweight desktop chat client (Windows, macOS) for a Redstart Nest or llama.cpp-compatible server on your local network.
author: Patrick Carswell

scripts.build: npm run build:chat && node ../../tooling/make-icon.mjs --variant twig && node ../../tooling/stage-node.mjs && node ../../tooling/rust-licenses.mjs --shell shell --out licenses/rust-licenses.json && node scripts/stage-shell-bundle.mjs && node scripts/build-shell.mjs
scripts.test: node scripts/test-fs-tool.mjs && node scripts/test-twigd.mjs && node scripts/test-beacon-origin.mjs && node scripts/test-network-scan.mjs
